decisions.reason: As the flagship launch most tightly tied to the firm's cloud messaging strategy, it remains strategically valuable and likely worth retaining even if it has been folded into broader offerings rather than prominently marketed on its own.

After several years without visible evidence of momentum, this more resource-demanding workflow extension looks less like an unresolved option and more like a peripheral offer whose resources are better redirected to core messaging and newer developments.

Despite modest promotion, it leverages the installed email and fax base and is likely relatively cheap to maintain, so management would keep this legacy-bridge option while it still supports regulated customer processes.
